title: Minecraft Creeper Farm Tutorial - NEW DESIGN - 3500~6500 P/H! 1.20.6
description:
Hello Guys TheySix is here With a New Minecraft Tutorial, In This Tutorial I Will Show you how to make a new simple creeper farm that was based on observers but in this farm with scaffoldings instead of observers in minecraft!

💕If you enjoyed the video, I would appreciate it, if you leave a like the video, and feel free to ask your questions! i will reply to all comments!
📝Important Details About the farm :
📚This farm uses mechanics based on 1 method using scaffoldings instead of observers and bypassing the light level of torches by using tinted glass blocks
📚If you Have a perimeter I recommend you build it in a perimeter 
the farm will be able to produce +6500 per hour with 12 layers!

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
